title: Vijay Pratap v. State of U.P. — writ withdrawn with liberty under Clause 6.5
coram: Sanjay Yadav, A.C.J. and Prakash Padia, J.
disposition: Dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to Clause 6.5.
headnote: On counsel's submission that the petitioner had a remedy under Clause 6.5 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005 (as amended on 10 August 2018), the Division Bench dismissed the writ petition as withdrawn with liberty to raise the grievance before the authority provided under that clause.
facts: Vijay Pratap filed a writ petition against the State of Uttar Pradesh and two others over electricity-related grievances. When the Division Bench took the matter through video conferencing, counsel submitted that the petitioner had a remedy under Clause 6.5 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005, as amended on 10 August 2018, and sought to withdraw the petition with liberty to approach the authority provided under that clause.

holding_units.holding: On counsel's submission that the petitioner had a remedy under Clause 6.5 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005 (as amended on 10 August 2018), the writ petition was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to raise the grievance before the authority concerned under that clause.

principle_tags.application: The Court accepted counsel's concession of a Clause 6.5 remedy and dismissed the writ as withdrawn with liberty to approach the authority under that clause, without examining the merits of the electricity grievance.

not_decided.point: Merits of the petitioner's electricity grievance
not_decided.note: The Court did not examine the underlying dispute; the petition was withdrawn with liberty to Clause 6.5.
